forum.title: STM32H5 Cannot enter system bootloader from software
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello,

Please check your startup file (startup\_stm32h523\*\*\*\*.s)

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/c6dd59af-b47f-49c3-98e9-40dac265a6bc.png)

The line “msr MSPLIM, r0” has been added in some version of cubeMx /IDE, and it prevents from jumping into the bootloader.

Indeed, the MSP of the bootloader is loaded at 0x200**0**3BE8

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/79718967-af33-427c-a33b-9c1afc4fc991.png)

When MSPLIM is probably set higher (on 272kB of RAM for instance, the limit would be 0x200**4**3B00 with a stack size of 0x500).

2 ways of solving this:

* Comment / remove the msr line

* Dynamically change the MSPLIM with a CMSIS command like : **\_\_set\_MSPLIM(0x20000000U);** just before jumping in the bootloader.

scraped_replies.html:
This code is awesome. It really works!

However, I keep encountering this issue, whereby after jumping to bootloader, I need to click on connect button twice to get it to connect properly. The first time, it keeps sending NACK, similar to what is observed here: 

Response received from device: NACKError: GETID command not acknowledged!Reemission of GetID commandResponse received from device: NACKError: GETID command not acknowledged!Reemission of GetID commandResponse received from device: NACKError: GETID command not acknowledged!Chip ID: 0x0

I trigger the jump via hyperterminal in my user application on USART1, disconnect the hyperterminal connection, and then connect using stm32cubeprogrammer UART mode on the same COM port on the laptop. I am also using USART1 for the bootloader. The timing from the jump to trying to connect the stm32cubeprogrammer is a few seconds since I’m doing the steps manually on my laptop.

I’ve tried to clear the DMA, UART1 flags, etc. Also tried 9600, 115200 baud rate. But it still doesn’t seem to help. But the second attempt seems to work just fine, consistently.
